biography.name: Misha Topchilo
biography.title: Engineering Lead
biography.lead: I lead engineering teams and own the architecture of what they build: from the first design decision, through delivery, to the system running in production.
now: I've spent **20+ years** building production software. Today I lead engineering on a large React and TypeScript platform at a **US enterprise software company**: I set the architecture and engineering standards for a distributed team, and built the testing and delivery pipeline that replaced manual regression testing with automated quality gates.

Before that, I spent five years as an **engineering team lead for a government IT contractor**, shipping federal and regional systems used by millions of citizens. Earlier, I worked as a full-stack engineer in media, telecom, and GIS.

bullets: Technical lead for a large React/TypeScript application; designed the component architecture now used across the organization.
Lead a distributed engineering team through hiring, onboarding, mentoring, and architecture and code reviews.
Work across the stack: Go services and the PostgreSQL data model behind the platform's APIs, keeping API contracts and the UI in sync.
Raised automated test coverage from near zero to 85%+ across unit, integration, and visual regression tests.
Built the CI/CD pipeline with SonarQube quality gates, replacing manual regression testing.
Introduced AI-assisted engineering: built MCP servers that connect coding agents to the team's internal engineering tools.
Short engagement that overlapped my move into the current lead role and wound down once that role was fully staffed.
Built a QA portal that gave engineering leadership visibility across 36 microservices for the first time.
Wrote UI test suites for each service from scratch and consolidated their quality metrics into a single dashboard.
Owned the technical lifecycle of a portfolio of high-traffic news sites under strict performance SLAs.
Ran the server infrastructure: provisioning, security hardening, patching, and disaster recovery.
Led a cross-functional team delivering systems for federal and regional government under strict compliance requirements.
Built the payment integration with state banking infrastructure for a federal cashback program used by millions of citizens at launch.
Took a citizen issue-reporting portal from zero to the region's primary municipal reporting channel.
Built a high-load news aggregation platform and a telecom billing system with subscriber management.
Designed the PostgreSQL spatial database and led the migration from a monolith to microservices.
